purpose: R04 second challenge: mandate, attribution of authority, organisational change and temporary continuity. No model reruns.

study_description.unit: Consumer-tool answers to selected recruitment questions, not observed buyers

selected_situations.label: First global payroll leader
selected_situations.analyst_test: Separate requested job remit, organisational reporting line and actual delegated authority; do not presume a new role receives a complete budget or signature right.

questions.prompt: We are a UK-headquartered company expanding across Europe and North America. We need our first Head of Global Payroll, based in the UK, to take ownership of multi-country payroll. Which recruitment firms should we speak to?
Who are the best recruiters for our first global payroll lead? We are based in the UK and growing in Europe and North America, and the hire will be UK-based.

We need a UK-based Head of Global Payroll for our expansion across Europe and North America. Which recruitment firms can help us define the role as well as find candidates, and what public evidence supports their experience?

Our CFO wants advice on the scope, salary and candidate market for a first UK-based global payroll leadership appointment covering Europe and North America. Which specialist recruiters can help shape the brief and then run the search?

selected_situations.unit: Saved model answers to researcher-written scenarios; not employers or buying events

selected_situations.label: Post-acquisition payroll integration
selected_situations.analyst_test: Separate integration leadership from legal-entity/provider authority and inherited local controls; the prompt’s one-director/CFO construction is not a discovered organisational structure.

questions.prompt: We are a UK-based, private-equity-backed group that has acquired businesses across the UK and Europe. We need a UK-based Group Payroll Director to integrate payroll teams, providers and controls. Which recruitment firms should we shortlist?
Which recruiters can find a Group Payroll Director for a UK buy-and-build business? We need someone who has integrated payroll after acquisitions in the UK and Europe.

For a UK-based Group Payroll Director appointment after several UK and European acquisitions, which specialist recruiters would you approach, and what would demonstrate that they understand payroll integration rather than general finance hiring?

Following several UK and European acquisitions, our UK group CFO wants one permanent Group Payroll Director to own the integration. Which recruitment agencies have a relevant senior payroll specialism, and which would you contact first?

selected_situations.unit: Saved model answers to researcher-written scenarios; not employers or buying events

selected_situations.label: Interim cover and permanent succession
selected_situations.analyst_test: Establish the actual authority and continuity arrangement during an interim or vacancy, its duration and handback; a six-month role or senior title does not transfer all outgoing rights.

questions.prompt: Our UK-based Global Head of Payroll is leaving before we can make a permanent replacement. We need an interim senior payroll leader for six months and support with the permanent search. Which specialist recruitment firms should we contact?
Who can find an interim Global Payroll Director in the UK while we recruit the permanent head? We need leadership cover for six months, not temporary payroll processing staff.

Which recruitment firms should we consider for six-month interim Global Payroll Director cover in the UK alongside a permanent leadership search? What should we verify about director-level availability, relevant multi-country experience and the handover between the two hires?

Our CFO needs six months of UK-based global payroll leadership cover, while our talent team recruits the permanent head. Which recruitment partners could handle both senior briefs and help us plan a workable handover?

can_transfer: Exact scenario wording can challenge the analyst coverage of alternative contexts.
Saved URLs/firm names may supply primary source leads requiring current independent inspection.
Mandate definition, changed authority and continuity/handover are questions to test in actual cases.
cannot_transfer: CFO primacy, single accountable person or permanent-head solution: some prompts explicitly assume these.
Actual employer demand, budget ownership, approval rights, prevalence, recruitment capability, available candidates, fee or service outcome.
Model recommendations/counts as buyer authority or as evidence of organisational decisions.
Full original capture completeness from answer count; partial and missing source records remain limited.
anti_anchoring_rule: Researcher-written CFO/single-leader/interim assumptions are deliberately treated as possible anchoring, not corroboration. Preserve unaided participant needs and actual events first; do not read these scenarios or a presumed hierarchy as mandatory questions.
